component.name: Splat Worker
component.summary: Train Gaussian splats for your Mac on this NVIDIA GPU

description.p: Splat Worker turns a Linux computer with an NVIDIA graphics card into a training server for Splat Studio on macOS. The Mac finds it automatically on the local network and sends it Gaussian-splat training and dataset processing jobs.

ul.li: One switch to start and stop the server
Guided setup that downloads the right PyTorch and gsplat build for your driver
Live GPU memory, temperature and utilisation
Job list with progress, PSNR, splat count and time remaining
Access token, Bonjour discovery and step-by-step help for connecting the Mac

description.p: Training requires an NVIDIA GPU (8 GB of video memory or more recommended) with a recent proprietary driver. The first-run setup downloads about 3 GB.

screenshot.caption: Server status with the GPU card and connection details
First-run setup of the GPU runtime

description.p: Install processing models remotely from Splat Studio; edge-aware depth, needle-splat penalty, and moving-object masking that switches off for sparse captures.
Optional processing models (COLMAP mapper, OWLv2, SAM 2) so Splat Studio can run camera solving and moving-object masking on this GPU.
Per-photo colour correction, live previews for Splat Studio, update notifications, and a fix for block-parallel training.
First Flatpak release with a desktop interface and guided GPU setup.
